messages:
takashi: paging oncall — alert from routing-alerts: multiple deployments routing to wrong model variant after schema push. saw fallback loop between eu-west-1 and eu-central-1, increased 503s.
oncall-bot: <@takashi> escalated to 1hr pager to group: oncall
maya: I'm on it, grabbing context. which PR?```yaml
routing_policies:
  - name: user-facing
    prefer_fallbacks: true
    regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
```
maya: that field was deprecated in last schema change (fallback_strategy now). looks like server-side default changed to "regional-loop" which reorders and triggers repeated cross-region reroutes.
samir: I'm seeing proxy logs with repeated 302-like reroutes and then upstream 503s. sample trace: router-382 -> eu-central -> eu-west -> eu-central... / kv cache misses stack up.
eva: customer-success flagged Acme and Foresite with higher latency and some 502s. estimate ~1.8% of hosted API traffic in EU window 10:05-10:23 UTC.
takashi: mitigation plan: 1) disable schema-compatibility check and revert to previous policy interpreter 2) set emergency override to prefer local region 3) mute canary autoscale
maya: applying emergency override now:```bash
redwood-routerctl set-override --policy user-facing --key fallback_strategy --value local-first --scope emergency
```
maya: override pushed, confirming routes now
samir: after override, loop stops, 503 rate dropping. still see some queued requests clearing respectively.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-20260315-72, severity: sev2, responders: @maya @samir @takashi, owner: maya
oncall-bot: handoff reminder: @maya will take first 60m, then hand to @samir for mitigation verification
maya: prepping rollback of schema change PR-4821 that introduced deprecated field handling. starting rollback now.
takashi: notify customers list via CS to acknowledge outage and mitigation steps. @customer-success can you prepare a short blurb?
customer-success: sending message to affected accounts: "We've identified a routing policy schema change that caused region fallback loops for some requests. We've applied an emergency override and are rolling back the change. We'll follow up with postmortem." Will include ETA for full resolution.
samir: root cause looks like a server-side default mapping when deprecated field present: prefer_fallbacks -> mapped to fallback_strategy: regional-loop. We need transformation to default to local-first when field present without explicit fallback_strategy.
maya: config team, flagging for patch PR. also need tests to assert explicit mapping and default behavior.
takashi: timeline notes: 10:04 alert, 10:06 pager, 10:09 override pushed, 10:18 rollback started, 10:23 service healthy thresholds met. postmortem owners: @samir + @maya
ops-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-fallbacks
maya: leaving handoff in 30m to @samir, monitoring for regressions. :eyes:
samir: will take over and follow up with postmortem and customer impact numbers. closing on-call loop after postmortem created.
